name: Dagster+ MCP
description: Queries Dagster+ assets, runs and pipeline health through Dagster's hosted MCP server: read run logs, launch runs and manage alert policies. For data engineering teams.

skills.name: Runs & Run Logs
skills.description: Views, launches and terminates Dagster+ runs and reads their run logs and Insights metrics to debug failing pipelines.

skills.name: Assets
skills.description: Views Dagster+ assets with their Insights metrics, launches assets, and deletes assets in your Dagster+ deployment.

skills.name: Alert Policies
skills.description: Views, creates, updates and deletes alert policies in your Dagster+ deployment from inside an AI session.

skills.name: Dagster+ Issues
skills.description: Views, creates and updates Dagster+ Issues so problems found in pipelines are tracked inside your deployment.

skills.name: Deployments
skills.description: Views Dagster+ deployments and their Insights metrics and deletes deployments you no longer need.
